title: Pan runner playbook
description: A private runner policy that selects compatible work and tells the agent how to deliver it.

capacity.description: Concurrent tasks this playbook may run. Set 0 to disable the playbook while keeping its configuration, for example while its workspace is in manual use.

workingDirectory.description: Absolute directory the agent is launched in. Set it when the playbook's instructions own workspace creation, so the runner prepares no worktree. Omit it to have the runner create and own an isolated task worktree.

instructions: Open a pull request against main that closes the Issue, then report needs-review.
Create an isolated workspace before editing, and deliver using the metarepo tooling.
